title: We Did Not Write This
why: Proof carousel for warm leads: real Google reviews, first name and last initial, no edits beyond trimming.
hook_options: We did not write any of this
What guests say when we are not in the room
caption: Own boat, own music, a few gators. Six real reviews from guests on Bayou Bienvenue, trimmed but not rewritten. Thank you to everyone who took the time. #neworleans #nolapartybarge #partyboat #bayoubienvenue

slides.headline: We did not write any of this
'We got our own boat'
slides.body: '...and hooked up our music and had the time of our life!!' The private fleet in one sentence.

slides.headline: 'Def recommend doing a private tour'
slides.body: '...if you have a large party of people.' Up to 25 fit on the biggest boats.

slides.headline: 'Also saw 3 gators.'
slides.body: 'We were celebrating a birthday... got to meet some new people.' Gators are common, not guaranteed.

slides.headline: 'Making the party boat a tradition'
slides.body: '...for my visits to NOLA from here on out.' Repeat guests are our favorite kind.

slides.headline: 'This is my second time going'
slides.body: '...and I always have a lot of fun when I go with my friends.'

slides.headline: Their own boat. Their own music. Gators.
slides.body: Read enough reviews and the same three things keep coming up.

slides.headline: Own boat, own music, real gators.
slides.body: The gators are common, not guaranteed. The music is up to you.
